name: Muske-GO 2024

venue.name: Muskego Circle Community Center
venue.address: S63W13694 W Janesville Rd, Muskego, WI 53150

information: This is Muskego's first WCA Competetition! **This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://worldcubeassociation.org/regulations). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf).** **If this is your first competition, please read the [FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MuskeGO2024#36892-faq) and the [New Competitor Info](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MuskeGO2024#37024-new-competitor-info) tab to learn more!** We have a local Facebook group for our Cubing Area. Please feel free to check out [Wisconsin & Illinois Speedcubing!](https://www.facebook.com/groups/2382471798653473) This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association.](https://www.midwestcubing.org/) ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBdVpjIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--a895d7c05042b98af75692453352612e7fa549cc/image.png)
